decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (535 01, 535 02, 535 03, 535 04, 535 05, 535 06, 535 07, 535 08, Flood Risk Assessment, Design and Access Statement, Photo Montage and Heritage Statement received 22/06/10 / 28/06/10. 535 09 b, 525 10 b, 535 11 b, 535 12 b, 535 13 b, 535 14b, 535 15b received 15/10/10) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 6 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.
description:
The listed building proposal for:
1)	The demolition of a side mono-pitched extension and the construction of a pitched roof to match existing. 
2)	Internal alterations and construction of winding staircase and rooflight due to demolition of existing staircase. 
3)	Change of front entrance gate. 
4)	Replacing windows and doors
